remarks: Truly beautiful, open floor plan townhouse.  Gorgeous kitchen with quartz counter tops, custom cabinets, double oven, and stainless appliances. Large, bright separate dining room that overlooks living room.  Light coming in from everywhere...2 sliders in large living room to private patio with wooded view. Bright entry foyer with palladium window and wide stairway to upper level bedrooms. Half bath on 1st floor with travertine flooring and new cabinet for guests.  Upgraded venting, lighting and electrical. Attractive, neutral window blinds included. Private front brick patio and private 2 car garage.  Each bedroom has it's own recently renovated full bath. Primary bedroom with walk-in closet and 2 additional closets, wood floors. Large second bedroom with wood floors and bath.  All windows replaced, 2 zones, attic insulation replaced, updated electrical panel, updated interior doors and molding throughout. Private, in unit storage. Too many feature and upgrades to list.....come and see!!!!  Walk/bike to Compo Beach, train, town. Stunning home and dynamite location.
